name: Nahum
bio: Nahum the Elkoshite prophesied the fall of Nineveh, capital of Assyria, over a century after Jonah had preached its repentance. He declared that the LORD is slow to anger but will not let the guilty go unpunished, and vividly described Nineveh's coming destruction as deserved judgment for its cruelty and idolatry, bringing relief and good news to Judah and all who had suffered under Assyrian oppression (Nahum 1:1-3:19).
